paragraphs.source_en: Once more, the two men grappled beneath the mottled shadows of the trees. Strangely, not a single man nearby intervened in their duel. By now, the battle had descended into utter chaos. Those advancing and those retreating alike were like headless flies, blundering blindly in every direction. Who had any thought left for another man?

units.source_en: Once more, the two men grappled beneath the mottled shadows of the trees.
units.source_zh: 二人再次在斑驳的树影中纠缠在一起。

units.source_en: Strangely, not a single man nearby intervened in their duel.
units.source_zh: 奇怪的是，周围没有一人介入格斗。

units.source_en: By now, the battle had descended into utter chaos.
units.source_zh: 战至此时，已完全陷入了混乱。

units.source_en: Those advancing and those retreating alike were like headless flies, blundering blindly in every direction. Who had any thought left for another man?

ja.t: ってはいられなかった。

units.source_zh: 无论前进者还是后退者，都成了无头的苍蝇，四处瞎撞，哪里还顾得上别人？

paragraphs.source_zh: 二人再次在斑驳的树影中纠缠在一起。奇怪的是，周围没有一人介入格斗。战至此时，已完全陷入了混乱。无论前进者还是后退者，都成了无头的苍蝇，四处瞎撞，哪里还顾得上别人？

paragraphs.source_en: “Yah!” At last, Denpachirō caught an opening in his opponent's guard and slashed at him.

units.source_en: “Yah!”
At last, Denpachirō caught an opening in his opponent's guard and slashed at him.
units.source_zh: 传八郎终于抓住对方的一个破绽，挥刀砍去。

paragraphs.source_zh: “呀！”传八郎终于抓住对方的一个破绽，挥刀砍去。

paragraphs.source_en: “A splendid stroke!” Shōnyū exclaimed in praise.

units.source_en: “A splendid stroke!”
units.source_zh: “好功夫！”

units.source_en: Shōnyū exclaimed in praise.
units.source_zh: 胜入夸赞一句。

paragraphs.source_en: Those proved to be the last words he ever spoke in this world. Denpachirō soared into the air like an eagle and came hurtling sideways, man and sword as one. In an instant, Shōnyū's head was severed from his body…

units.source_en: Those proved to be the last words he ever spoke in this world.
units.source_zh: 这却成了他在这世上的最后一句话。

units.source_en: Denpachirō soared into the air like an eagle and came hurtling sideways, man and sword as one. In an instant, Shōnyū's head was severed from his body…
units.source_zh: 传八郎如雄鹰一样腾空而起，人和刀一起横飞过来，胜入顿时身首异处……

paragraphs.source_zh: 这却成了他在这世上的最后一句话。传八郎如雄鹰一样腾空而起，人和刀一起横飞过来，胜入顿时身首异处……

paragraphs.source_en: Denpachirō landed squarely, but in the next instant stood rooted to the spot, suddenly hollow with loss. A shower of blood spattered the trampled, ravaged grass, glowing with startling vividness in the brilliant sunlight. His ears rang; a wave of numbness swept through him, and he could scarcely feel half his body.

units.source_en: Denpachirō landed squarely, but in the next instant stood rooted to the spot, suddenly hollow with loss.
units.source_zh: 传八郎稳稳落下，瞬间却怅然若失地愣在了当地。

units.source_en: A shower of blood spattered the trampled, ravaged grass, glowing with startling vividness in the brilliant sunlight.
units.source_zh: 血雨飞溅到被践踏得一片狼藉的草地上，在灿烂的阳光的映照下，显得格外鲜艳。

units.source_en: His ears rang; a wave of numbness swept through him, and he could scarcely feel half his body.
units.source_zh: 他只觉得耳朵嗡了一声，全身一阵酸麻，大半个身子几失去知觉。

paragraphs.source_zh: 传八郎稳稳落下，瞬间却怅然若失地愣在了当地。血雨飞溅到被践踏得一片狼藉的草地上，在灿烂的阳光的映照下，显得格外鲜艳。他只觉得耳朵嗡了一声，全身一阵酸麻，大半个身子几失去知觉。

units.source_en: “I have won!”
units.source_zh: “胜了！”

paragraphs.source_en: Yet the victory was not his alone; Shōnyū, too, had done nothing to tarnish the illustrious name of a lifetime. Was it not a rare and heroic feat to win praise even from one's enemy? Denpachirō took the celebrated sword Sasayuki from Shōnyū's hand, unfastened its scabbard from the corpse, and sheathed the blade.

units.source_en: Yet the victory was not his alone; Shōnyū, too, had done nothing to tarnish the illustrious name of a lifetime.
units.source_zh: 胜利的不只是他一人，胜入也完全没有辱没一世英名。

units.source_en: Was it not a rare and heroic feat to win praise even from one's enemy?
units.source_zh: 连敌人都夸奖，岂非难得的壮举？

units.source_en: Denpachirō took the celebrated sword Sasayuki from Shōnyū's hand, unfastened its scabbard from the corpse, and sheathed the blade.
units.source_zh: 传八郎从胜入手里取过名刀筱雪，再从尸身上解下刀鞘，把刀插入鞘中。

paragraphs.source_zh: 胜利的不只是他一人，胜入也完全没有辱没一世英名。连敌人都夸奖，岂非难得的壮举？传八郎从胜入手里取过名刀筱雪，再从尸身上解下刀鞘，把刀插入鞘中。

paragraphs.source_en: Yet no one came to congratulate him; only the corpses strewn across the ground seemed to clap and laugh in unison. Having taken Shōnyū's head, Denpachirō broke into a frenzied run toward Ieyasu's standard.

units.source_en: Yet no one came to congratulate him; only the corpses strewn across the ground seemed to clap and laugh in unison.

ja.t: っているかのようだった。

units.source_zh: 然而，没有人前来祝贺，只有满地的尸体似在齐齐拍手欢笑。

units.source_en: Having taken Shōnyū's head, Denpachirō broke into a frenzied run toward Ieyasu's standard.
units.source_zh: 取得胜入首级的传八郎发疯似的撒开腿，向着家康的旗号飞奔而去。

paragraphs.source_zh: 然而，没有人前来祝贺，只有满地的尸体似在齐齐拍手欢笑。取得胜入首级的传八郎发疯似的撒开腿，向着家康的旗号飞奔而去。

paragraphs.source_en: Silence settled over the place. From nowhere, a vast swarm of flies appeared, descending in a black mass upon Shōnyū's headless corpse as it lay exposed beneath the sun, and began greedily sucking at it…

units.source_en: Silence settled over the place. From nowhere, a vast swarm of flies appeared, descending in a black mass upon Shōnyū's headless corpse as it lay exposed beneath the sun, and began greedily sucking at it…

ja.t: った。どこからともなく

units.source_zh: 四周安静了下来，不知从何处涌来一大群苍蝇，黑压压地一齐落在曝晒在阳光下的胜入的无头尸体上，贪婪地吮吸起来……

paragraphs.source_zh: 四周安静了下来，不知从何处涌来一大群苍蝇，黑压压地一齐落在曝晒在阳光下的胜入的无头尸体上，贪婪地吮吸起来……

paragraphs.source_en: By then, Motosuke, Governor of Kii, had also fallen in battle. Only Sanzaemon Terumasa, still unaware that his father and elder brother were dead, continued fighting desperately in the hope of reversing the defeat.

units.source_en: By then, Motosuke, Governor of Kii, had also fallen in battle.
units.source_zh: 此时，纪伊守元助也已经战死。

units.source_en: Only Sanzaemon Terumasa, still unaware that his father and elder brother were dead, continued fighting desperately in the hope of reversing the defeat.
units.source_zh: 只有尚不知道父兄已逝的三左卫门辉政，还在拼命地厮杀，想挽回败局。

paragraphs.source_zh: 此时，纪伊守元助也已经战死。只有尚不知道父兄已逝的三左卫门辉政，还在拼命地厮杀，想挽回败局。

paragraphs.source_en: But the outcome had already been decided.

units.source_en: But the outcome had already been decided.
units.source_zh: 但，胜负已定。

paragraphs.source_en: A clarion blast rang out. The Tokugawa army, seeing that victory was now complete, had likely begun mustering its men. Only the swarming flies continued to gather in ever greater numbers beneath the brilliant sun…

units.source_en: A clarion blast rang out. The Tokugawa army, seeing that victory was now complete, had likely begun mustering its men.
units.source_zh: 嘹亮的号角响起，恐是德川的军队看到已完全取胜，开始清点人数了。

units.source_en: Only the swarming flies continued to gather in ever greater numbers beneath the brilliant sun…
units.source_zh: 只有那成群的苍蝇，在灿烂的阳光下越聚越多……

paragraphs.source_zh: 嘹亮的号角响起，恐是德川的军队看到已完全取胜，开始清点人数了。只有那成群的苍蝇，在灿烂的阳光下越聚越多……
